titulo: Mideast live: Yemen’s Houthis say they targeted military facilities in Saudi Arabia
cuerpo: Yemen's Houthis on Monday said they fired dozens of drones and ballistic missiles at military targets in Saudi Arabia as the rebels stepped up attacks on Saudi infrastructure while advancing along Yemen's Red Sea coast towards ​the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a key shipping route. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
